name: project the interpolated step into a shrinking bisection window
mechanism: compute the chord's zero, nudge it toward the midpoint by a controlled amount, then clip it into a window around the midpoint whose width shrinks so that the worst case still halves the bracket like bisection; on smooth functions the clipped step is the fast one

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'ITP method' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Root finding: minmax optimal and superlinear convergence simultaneously

fails_when: nothing in the worst case beyond bisection; constants matter for the average case
